headline: "If I Escape, I Won't Work at the Bank Again": As KOSPI Soars, Individual Investors Dump Domestic ETFs [Investment 360]
summary: KOSPI rose more than 17% on the 31st of last month, its largest gain on record, while individual investors sold large amounts of domestic equity ETFs during the rebound.
why: The KOSPI is South Korea's benchmark stock index, and large swings in it affect Korean equities, retail flows and the won.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: The benchmark index recorded its largest one-day gain on record in the period described.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The index rebounded sharply, and individual investors used the rebound to sell domestic equity ETFs, according to the report.
